problem: Held-out CB13_03 backscatter has WGS84 horizontal coordinates inside a compound CRS, so native x/y degree steps are anisotropic in metres.

solution.horizontal_crs_rule: Treat only the horizontal sub-CRS as WGS84/EPSG:4326; preserve vertical LAT-depth metadata without using it for horizontal metric geometry.
solution.reference_location_rule: Use exact midpoint of frozen backscatter header bounds.
solution.patch_rule: For each frozen radius r, construct one fixed native-grid mask using d=sqrt((dc*dx_m)^2+(dr*dy_m)^2), disk d<=r, annulus 1.25r<d<=2r. Reuse identical mask for every candidate and control in that radius stratum.
solution.first_difference_rule: Median absolute native first differences between adjacent valid pixels whose pair lies within the physical disk mask; no interpolation or resampling.

unchanged_v2.zero_mad_rule: exclude metric when same-radius eligible-control MAD is exactly zero
unchanged_v2.aggregate_score: 0.5*max(active positive robust z)+0.5*mean(active positive robust z)
